boards: Use case: stylized-concept, photoreal architectural rendering. Create board 01-dawn-exterior, exactly 1536x1024 landscape, single image, no collage. Reference photos show the actual Space house street facade and gate; preserve this specific asymmetrical white lime-plastered Bengaluru modernist house, three floors above concealed basement, flat roofs, stepped roofline, deep rectangular window reveals with teak frames, modest charcoal railings and grey slatted street gate. Pull back to show the WHOLE house, composed alone in soft grey-pink dawn fog at 6 am. Frontal street camera 1.6m high, 50mm architectural lens, straight verticals, house centered and occupies about 45% canvas width, generous empty fog on all sides. Gulmohar trees with very restrained orange-red blossoms flank the house. Soft volumetric haze hides all neighbors; faint street plane only. Pale warm grey, lime white, muted foliage, one small orange-red accent. Quiet grounded photoreal render, natural material texture. Remove cars, wires, neighboring buildings, signs, labels, visible numbers, text, logos, people. No sci-fi, no mountains, no extra building, no floating plinth, no dramatic beams. No UI. Exact architectural survey is not required but proportions must follow photographed house rather than generic villa.

Edit this dawn architectural board to make it much quieter. EXACT 1536x1024 landscape. Preserve the same house geometry, three storeys, stepped roof, window placements, teak frames, white plaster and grey gate. Pull camera back so house occupies 40 percent width and 55 percent height, centered with enormous empty margins of pale grey-pink volumetric fog. Remove ALL foreground framing leaves, large left tree, background forest, shrubs, ferns and landscaping clutter. Keep ONLY two small sparse gulmohar trees immediately flanking house, with a few orange-red blossoms, not obscuring most windows. Remove sun disc and sun flare. Fade bottom gate and street edges gently into fog. Flat soft diffuse 6 am lighting. House alone, solitary stillness, architectural render with realistic textures. No people, no text, no numbers, no neighbors, no labels.

Edit reference board 1. EXACT 1536x1024 landscape. Same house, exact same camera, framing, geometry and image position. A fog transition: pale WARM grey fog now swallows the entire house, trees, street, gate and windows. ONLY the faint upper stepped roofline remains visible, whisper thin silhouette in middle of warm fog. No visible facade, no labels, no people, no text. Extremely quiet nearly empty atmospheric photoreal frame. No new objects. Fog is same soft volumetric treatment as reference, increased opacity as deliberate transition.

Edit reference board 1, EXACT 1536x1024 landscape. Change only light and time to 10 pm. Preserve EXACT same closed three-storey house, stepped roofline, plaster, window placements, gate, two sparse gulmohars, camera position and house size. Deep dark blue night fog with same softness and spatial density. Every visible window glowing warm amber, small delicate warm string lights on roof terrace, subtle warm spill in window reveals. Faint street visible at bottom fading to fog. Restrained dark monochrome with amber as sole warm accent. Quiet members house lit within, no nightclub signage. No people, no text, no numbers, no neighbors, no extra lights, no neon, no stars, no moon, no cars.

Use reference board 1 as exact unaltered background. EXACT 1536x1024 landscape screen chrome mockup. Preserve entire dawn image, house, proportions, camera, fog, colors unchanged. Add only four tiny discreet charcoal monospace labels, 20 px type, 48 px inset from screen corners: top-left wordmark "SPACE"; top-right "Book a call"; bottom-left "Scroll"; bottom-right "06:00 IST". Corner labels ONLY, no panel backgrounds, no callout lines, no extra typography, no labels on house, no large headline. Calm restrained editorial architectural homepage.

Same white lime-plastered modernist house as dawn reference, same realistic teak and plaster textures and soft volumetric fog treatment. One architectural subject centered alone, about half the canvas width, abundant quiet negative space. 50mm architectural lens. Restrained pale neutral palette with one warm material/light accent; surroundings disappear into fog. No text, no numbers, no labels, no UI, no neighbors, no vehicles, no props beyond those specified. Floor isolation is a conceptual section, not a new standalone pavilion. Board 03: isolate only ground-floor living room, upper storeys lifted completely out of view, open top architectural cutaway with real enclosing white walls and deep teak-framed glazed doors to small lawn disappearing into warm pale fog. Keep rectangular room proportions and polished teak plank floor from photo p25. Exactly TWO small cafe tables, each with two modest teak chairs, two brass lanterns suspended discreetly from retained slender beam. Empty room, no people. Soft morning daylight through glazed doors, teak amber as single warm accent. Slightly elevated camera looking into isolated room, not extreme top-down, maintain calm frontal orientation of hero. No cafe counter, kitchen, furniture clutter, extra rooms or floating slabs.

Pull camera back until room occupies only 48% width and 60% height of canvas, centered, with enormous empty pale warm-grey fog margins. Remove ghost background trees completely. Upper floor is lifted away: remove entire ceiling plane, leave only slender beam supporting two brass lanterns. No ceiling fan. Keep three enclosing walls and open top. Soft morning light, calmer less orange grading. Conceptual ground floor section in fog, no extra furniture or text.

Use case: productivity-visual material art direction board. Generate EXACT 1536x1024 landscape PNG, flat editorial board on warm off-white background. Clean restrained monospace typography in charcoal, large whitespace, no decorative props, no architecture scene. Title small top-left "SPACE / MATERIALS + ATMOSPHERE". Upper section: eight evenly sized rectangular realistic flat material texture swatches in 4 columns x 2 rows, with precise small names and HEX beneath. Row 1: "LIME WHITE / #E8E4DA" textured lime plaster; "TEAK / #805238" fine warm teak grain; "TERRAZZO / #CBC4B5" subtle small aggregate cream terrazzo; "SANDSTONE / #B3A68B" matte sandstone flagstone. Row 2: "TERRACOTTA / #B66E51" terracotta clay; "RED OXIDE / #884B45" smooth oxide floor; "CHARCOAL STEEL / #383B3A" matte charcoal steel; "FOLIAGE / #59634D" muted olive foliage green. Texture references are real house photographs: use p16 for terrazzo, p15 for red oxide, p08 for steel, p33 for terracotta and p11 for sandstone and teak. Bottom section separated with thin line and small heading "FOG / SAMPLED FROM BOARDS 01–06": six flat color chips in a single horizontal row, exact following labels: "01 DAWN / #D1BFC2"; "02 TRANSITION / #CFBDC0"; "03 MORNING / #BDB0B2"; "04 AFTERNOON / #CEC0C0"; "05 SUNDOWN / #786C7D"; "06 NIGHT / #1C2D4C". These are fog colors from generated boards, show as solid swatches, not gradients. Legible accurate text, no additional labels. Square corners, no cards or shadows or 3D sample blocks. Calm flat design, material textures only inside upper rectangles.
